definition: Reciprocal Human Machine Learning (RHML) is an interdisciplinary approach to designing human-AI interaction systems.
details: RHML aims to enable continual learning between humans and machine learning models by having them learn from each other. This approach keeps the human expert "in the loop" to oversee and enhance machine learning performance and simultaneously support the human expert continue learning.
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. And that idea, made concrete, is Reciprocal human machine learning.
